subject.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally rename only previously unsafe or colliding bundled LSP tool names on upgrade while preserving every already-valid complete name?
rationale: Invalid names cannot be carried forward across provider contracts, but policy entries that happened to reference old provider-specific output may change; accepting that bounded compatibility effect is an owner decision rather than an implementation defect.

options.title: Accept bounded normalization
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks pass, treating renamed unsafe or colliding names as the necessary provider-safe repair while preserving valid names.

options.title: Require upgrade guidance first
options.body: Pause merge until user-facing tool-policy guidance explicitly explains how repaired LSP names are derived and how affected allow or deny entries should be updated.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded normalization
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks pass, treating renamed unsafe or colliding names as the necessary provider-safe repair while preserving valid names.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged bundle MCP namespacing work established the closest existing invariant and policy interaction.
